author: Oblivion_D2
body:
Which platform? Teamspeak, In-game, Slack?:  In-Game
 
Staff Member: Javipepe

Guilty? (Yes or No): Yes

Why do you think you should be unbanned?:  I was banned almost two years ago and I have matured a lot since,  I was 13 then and I'm 15 now.  I know that what I did was wrong but I really, really miss this server.  I un-downloaded hacks once I got banned and even stopped playing Minecraft for a while.  I know what I did was wrong but I have changed, and I have even become a mod on a server,  I am now loyal and trustworthy.  I really hope you can consider unbanning me.  

Any additional comments?:
Happy Holidays :)
